remediation.why: a bare `--` inside an HTML comment is non-conforming under XML/XHTML and HTML 4. It does NOT terminate an HTML5 comment -- measured in Chromium, this header parses as one comment node with its text intact and nothing spilled into the document -- so the fixture was never mis-parsed by the parser that actually reads it. Removed anyway, because the cost is two words and it makes the file valid under stricter tooling too
remediation.scope: the generated header comment only: `SCRUBBED FIXTURE --` and the redacted href placeholder. The DOM payload below the comment is byte-identical, asserted by a complement diff at edit time
remediation.invariant: everything from the comment's `-->` onward is unchanged, so every pre-scrub measurement above still describes this file
remediation.tool: scripts/harvest-dom-fixture.mjs no longer emits `--` into the header, so a fresh harvest produces this form directly
